name: Chincoteague
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Chincoteague?
answer_short: Yes, with limits. In Chincoteague, registered golf carts may use streets the Town Council designates, posted 25 mph or less, but never Main Street or Second Street.

golf_cart.roads: Designated streets posted 25 mph or less
golf_cart.notes: Town registration; not Main St or Second St

rules.rule: Only on designated streets posted 25 mph or less; not Main St or Second St
LSVs on highways posted 35 mph or less

banned_roads.name: Main Street
banned_roads.rule: No golf carts; cross at Sycamore, Fifth or Third St

banned_roads.name: Second Street
banned_roads.rule: No golf carts; cross at Marshall or Endly St

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Chincoteague?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Main Street in Chincoteague?
faq.a: No. Golf carts may only cross Main Street at Sycamore, Fifth and Third Streets.

faq.q: Do I need to register a golf cart in Chincoteague?
faq.a: Yes. The town requires registration, proof of insurance and a $25 yearly decal.
